en: Tinted historic postcard view of a large monument in an open square, with a tall statue of a robed figure atop a multi-tiered pedestal adorned with reliefs and sculptural groups. People stroll around the fenced monument, and behind it are trees, buildings, and a bell tower set against a backdrop of mountains. The caption at the top left reads "Trient, Dantedenkmal."
